lines: Like difference-view before eternal Śiva, among liberated-Śivas at creation-dissolution-work: from mild-intense descent, longing for a good guru arises; in a bad guru, only concealment; from bad-guru-ness, the good-guru-way comes by descent itself.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhedadarśana iva anādiśivasaṃnidhau muktaśivānāṃ sṛṣṭilayādikṛtyeṣu mandatīvrāt śaktipātāt sadguruviṣayā yiyāsā bhavati asadguruviṣayāyāṃ tu tirobhāva eva asadgurutas tu sadgurugamanaṃ śaktipātād eva

reads_against.argmap: How does difference-view relate to guru-seeking? → Tirobhāva vs yiyāsā: the same descent that conceals under a bad guru drives approach to a good one — bad-guru-lessness is śaktipāta-born.
c1_essence: Difference-view drives guru-seeking: bad-guru concealment, good-guru-approach born of the same descent.
